name: research-report-loop-memory
description: Integrated report writing loop with L0/L1 evidence and Git-backed L2B Rubrics

scripts.test: npm run test:memory && npm run test:loop
scripts.test:memory: node --import tsx --test mcp/test/mcp.integration.test.ts mcp/test/relevance.test.ts mcp/test/rubric-repository.test.ts mcp/test/storage-layout-v2.test.ts mcp/test/user-shortcut.test.ts mcp/test/integrated-contract.test.ts mcp/test/asset-path.test.ts mcp/test/curator-prompt-variants.test.ts mcp/test/capture-hook.test.ts mcp/test/reflection.test.ts mcp/test/windows-package.test.ts
scripts.test:loop: node scripts/run-python-command.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
scripts.syntaxcheck: tsc --noEmit --noCheck && node --check hooks/capture-checkpoint.mjs && node scripts/run-python-command.mjs -m compileall -q mcp/report_loop
